approach: The game's five packed MIPS R3000A executables are unpacked and translated to C at build time and linked with an HLE PS1 runtime (GTE, software GPU, SPU, CD-ROM, MDEC); BIOS Exec switches between them.
notes: Intro FMV, Arcade Mode races and Simulation Mode's map, menus and license tests run at full speed with music. 4x internal resolution with sub-pixel vertices, 16:9 widescreen, save states. Not yet tested: car purchases, championships, replays, two-player, memory card saves.
